extraction_notes: The BZT52C12 row specifies nominal VZ = 12 V, minimum VZ = 11.40 V, maximum VZ = 12.60 V, IZT = 5 mA, ZZT maximum = 25 ohm, ZZK maximum = 150 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, IR maximum = 0.1 uA at VR = 8 V, and admissible current IZM = 5 mA.
The zener characteristic points are digitized from the labeled 12 V family curve in Fig. 2; the plotted voltage axis is linear and the plotted current axis is logarithmic.
The capacitance points are digitized from the family curves in Fig. 3. The representative capacitance spec uses the 0 V bias curve at nominal VZ = 12 V.
The datasheet specifies PD = 350 mW in the maximum ratings on page 1, while the characteristic plots on page 3 are marked PD = 500 mW; the plot condition is preserved as printed.
Only one forward-voltage maximum point is published: VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA. No forward-IV table or forward-IV plot was found.
Reverse recovery time is not published.
